headerDisplay: Controls a Systemair/Villavent VR-700 residential ventilation unit over an RS485<->WiFi adapter (e.g. Elfin EW11) wired to the wall-panel terminals.

name.title: Name
name.description: Base name; creates "<Name> Speed" and "<Name> Temperature".

ip.title: IP address of the WiFi module
ip.description: IP address of the EW11 (RS485<->WiFi adapter).

port.title: TCP port
port.description: Usually 502. Must match the TCP server port configured on the EW11 under Communication Settings.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Logs EVERY received and sent byte plus statistics (valid frames vs. discarded bytes) to the Homebridge log. Enable only for targeted debugging, it produces a lot of log lines - disable again afterwards.

learn.title: Learn mode
learn.description: Records the correct control frames of YOUR unit instead of using the bundled default frames. When active, the plugin SENDS NOTHING to the unit and only listens: step through all fan and temperature levels on the original (parallel-connected) wall panel and the plugin captures them automatically (progress shown in the log). Set back to false afterwards. Learned frames are stored persistently and preferred in normal operation.
